record.name: Enforcer
record.description: Enforcers impose their will through calculated force—breaking lines with shock tactics, subduing dissent, and forcing compliance through fear.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Brutal enforcers impose their will through calculated force.

progression_tree.description: Increase your intimidation modifier by +1. Your attacks now deal an additional 2d6 force damage on critical hits.

effects.notes: When you hit with an attack, your body surges with adrenaline, granting a burst of strength. For the duration of this combat, you have advantage on Strength checks.

progression_tree.description: Your melee attacks have a +1 bonus to hit. When you score a critical hit, you can attempt to knock the target prone.

effects.notes: Upon landing a hit, the Enforcer's sheer force crushes their opponent, dealing +1d6 bludgeoning damage.

progression_tree.description: You can use your reaction to move up to your speed and make a melee attack. Your next attack roll within the same turn has advantage.

effects.notes: The Enforcer unleashes a brutal slam, dealing an additional +1d8 bludgeoning damage with their melee attack.

progression_tree.description: Your melee attacks have a +2 bonus to hit. When you score a critical hit, you can attempt to knock the target prone and make another attack.

effects.notes: When Enforcer strikes an enemy, their massive fist glances off the opponent's armor, causing a dull shockwave that drains some of their vitality. The target takes +2 damage from subsequent attacks.

progression_tree.description: You have advantage on all Intimidation checks. Your melee attacks now deal an additional 4d6 force damage on critical hits.

effects.notes: Upon striking an enemy, Enforcer's brute strength crashes down upon them, causing all their attacks to deal one additional damage roll for the remainder of combat.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assuming a wide stance with knees slightly bent, weight shifted forward, and eyes fixed intently on the target.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A bright blue aura emanating from the Enforcer's hands, crackling with contained electrical energy that builds in intensity as they prepare to strike.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A hulking Enforcer in a dimly lit cantina, surrounded by hooded figures and the faint glow of holographic advertisements
contextual_modifiers: Increase lighting contrast to emphasize dramatic shadows
Show the Enforcer's blaster at a 45-degree angle, muzzle aimed directly at the target
